title: Software Engineer
summary: Designs, builds, tests and maintains software applications and services, working in an agile team with version control and code review.
responsibilities: Design, develop and maintain software features from requirements to release
Write clean, tested, maintainable code and participate in code reviews
Build and consume REST APIs and integrate third-party services
Debug and resolve production issues and performance bottlenecks
Collaborate with product, QA and design in an agile team
Write unit and integration tests and maintain documentation

title: Java Backend Developer
summary: Builds secure, scalable server-side applications and REST APIs in Java using Spring Boot, relational databases and cloud tooling.
responsibilities: Design and implement RESTful APIs and microservices with Spring Boot
Model data and write optimized queries with JPA/Hibernate and SQL
Implement authentication and authorization with Spring Security and JWT
Write unit and integration tests with JUnit and Mockito
Containerize and deploy services using Docker and CI/CD pipelines
Profile and tune application performance and troubleshoot production issues

title: Full Stack Developer
summary: Delivers complete web features across the user interface, server-side logic, APIs and databases.
responsibilities: Build responsive user interfaces and connect them to backend APIs
Design and implement server-side services, databases and authentication
Write reusable components and maintainable, tested code
Deploy and monitor web applications in cloud environments
Optimize page performance, accessibility and SEO
Work with designers and product owners to ship features iteratively

title: Frontend Developer
summary: Builds fast, accessible, responsive web interfaces with modern JavaScript frameworks and design systems.
responsibilities: Translate designs into responsive, accessible UI components
Manage application state and integrate REST or GraphQL APIs
Optimize rendering performance and bundle size
Write unit and end-to-end tests for components and flows
Maintain a shared component library and design system
Ensure cross-browser compatibility and accessibility compliance

title: Python Developer
summary: Develops backend services, automation and data-driven applications in Python using web frameworks and databases.
responsibilities: Build and maintain backend services and REST APIs in Python
Design database schemas and write efficient queries
Automate workflows and data processing tasks with scripts
Write automated tests with pytest and enforce code quality
Deploy and monitor services on cloud infrastructure
Integrate third-party APIs and background task queues

title: Node.js Backend Developer
summary: Builds scalable APIs and real-time services with Node.js, Express and NoSQL or SQL databases.
responsibilities: Design and build RESTful APIs and real-time services with Node.js
Model data in MongoDB or SQL databases and optimize queries
Implement authentication, authorization and input validation
Write automated tests and maintain API documentation
Deploy containerized services and monitor performance
Handle asynchronous workflows, queues and caching

title: Data Analyst
summary: Turns raw data into insight using SQL, spreadsheets, statistics and dashboards that inform business decisions.
responsibilities: Query, clean and transform data from multiple sources using SQL and Python
Build dashboards and reports that track KPIs for stakeholders
Perform exploratory analysis and statistical testing to find trends
Translate business questions into analytical approaches
Present findings and recommendations to non-technical audiences
Validate data quality and document metrics definitions

title: Data Scientist
summary: Builds statistical and machine learning models to solve business problems and communicates results to stakeholders.
responsibilities: Explore and prepare data, engineer features and select appropriate models
Train, evaluate and tune machine learning models
Design experiments and A/B tests and interpret results
Deploy models with engineers and monitor their performance
Communicate insights and model limitations to stakeholders
Document methodology and ensure reproducible analysis

title: Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Productionizes machine learning and LLM systems: training pipelines, serving, monitoring and scalable inference.
responsibilities: Build and automate training and evaluation pipelines
Deploy models as scalable, low-latency services
Monitor model quality, drift and cost in production
Optimize inference performance and resource usage
Collaborate with data scientists and software engineers
Build retrieval-augmented and LLM-based applications with evaluation

title: Data Engineer
summary: Designs and maintains reliable data pipelines, warehouses and lakes that power analytics and machine learning.
responsibilities: Build and orchestrate batch and streaming data pipelines
Model and optimize warehouse and lake storage
Ensure data quality, lineage and monitoring
Tune SQL and Spark jobs for performance and cost
Collaborate with analysts and data scientists on data needs
Automate deployments and infrastructure for data platforms

title: DevOps Engineer
summary: Automates build, deployment and infrastructure, and keeps services reliable through monitoring and incident response.
responsibilities: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test and release
Provision and manage infrastructure as code
Run and scale containerized workloads on Kubernetes
Implement monitoring, logging and alerting
Respond to incidents and lead blameless post-mortems
Improve reliability, security and deployment speed

title: Cloud Engineer
summary: Designs, deploys and secures cloud infrastructure and services across compute, storage, networking and identity.
responsibilities: Design and deploy scalable, highly available cloud architectures
Automate infrastructure provisioning with code
Manage identity, access and network security
Monitor performance and optimize cloud costs
Migrate workloads to the cloud
Document architectures and operational runbooks

title: QA Engineer
summary: Ensures software quality through test planning, manual and automated testing and defect tracking.
responsibilities: Create test plans, scenarios and detailed test cases from requirements
Execute functional, regression and integration tests
Build and maintain automated UI and API test suites
Log, triage and verify defects with clear reproduction steps
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Collaborate with developers and product owners on quality

title: Android Developer
summary: Builds native Android applications with Kotlin or Java, modern architecture patterns and Jetpack libraries.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain Android applications using Kotlin
Implement MVVM architecture with Jetpack components
Integrate REST APIs and handle local storage
Optimize app performance, memory and battery use
Write unit and UI tests and publish releases to Google Play
Collaborate with designers and backend teams

title: iOS Developer
summary: Builds native iOS applications with Swift and SwiftUI following Apple design and architecture best practices.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain iOS applications using Swift
Build interfaces with SwiftUI and UIKit
Integrate APIs and manage persistence with Core Data
Profile and optimize performance with Instruments
Write tests and ship releases through the App Store
Follow Apple Human Interface Guidelines

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
summary: Protects systems and data by monitoring threats, assessing vulnerabilities and responding to security incidents.
responsibilities: Monitor security events and investigate alerts in a SIEM
Run vulnerability scans and track remediation
Respond to and document security incidents
Assess risks and recommend security controls
Harden systems and review access controls
Support compliance audits and security awareness

title: UI/UX Designer
summary: Designs intuitive user experiences through research, wireframes, prototypes and visual design systems.
responsibilities: Conduct user research and synthesize insights into personas and journeys
Create wireframes, prototypes and high-fidelity designs
Run usability tests and iterate on feedback
Maintain and extend a consistent design system
Collaborate with product managers and engineers on handoff
Design for accessibility and responsive layouts

title: Product Manager
summary: Defines product strategy and roadmap, prioritizes work and aligns stakeholders to deliver measurable user and business outcomes.
responsibilities: Define product vision, strategy and a prioritized roadmap
Write requirements and user stories and manage the backlog
Use research and data to validate problems and measure impact
Align engineering, design and business stakeholders
Plan and track launches and iterate on feedback
Define success metrics and report on outcomes

title: Business Analyst
summary: Bridges business needs and technical teams by gathering requirements, modeling processes and validating solutions.
responsibilities: Elicit, document and prioritize business requirements
Model processes and identify improvement opportunities
Write BRDs, functional specifications and user stories
Analyze data to support decisions and measure results
Coordinate user acceptance testing and sign-off
Communicate with stakeholders and technical teams

title: Project Manager
summary: Plans, executes and delivers projects on time and budget by managing scope, risk, resources and stakeholders.
responsibilities: Define scope, schedule and budget and track progress
Identify, assess and mitigate project risks
Run sprint ceremonies and remove team blockers
Communicate status to stakeholders and leadership
Manage resources, vendors and dependencies
Drive continuous improvement and lessons learned

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
summary: Plans and optimizes online campaigns across search, social, email and content to grow traffic, leads and revenue.
responsibilities: Plan, launch and optimize paid and organic campaigns
Perform keyword research and on-page SEO
Create and schedule content across channels
Track performance in analytics and report ROI
Run A/B tests to improve conversion
Manage budgets and collaborate with sales and design

title: HR Executive
summary: Manages recruitment, onboarding, employee relations and HR operations while ensuring policy and legal compliance.
responsibilities: Source, screen and interview candidates and manage offers
Coordinate onboarding and employee documentation
Maintain HR records and policies in an HRIS
Handle employee queries and support engagement
Support payroll, performance reviews and compliance
Report on hiring and HR metrics

title: Accountant
summary: Maintains accurate financial records, reconciliations, reporting and tax compliance for the organization.
responsibilities: Record transactions and maintain general ledgers
Prepare bank, vendor and customer reconciliations
Prepare financial statements and management reports
Handle GST, TDS and statutory filings
Support audits and budgeting
Process invoices, payments and collections

title: Sales Executive
summary: Generates and closes revenue through prospecting, relationship management and consultative selling.
responsibilities: Prospect and qualify leads through multiple channels
Present solutions and negotiate and close deals
Maintain pipeline and activity in a CRM
Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly sales targets
Build long-term client relationships and renewals
Report on forecasts and market feedback
